    def add_visit(self, visit: Visit) -> None:
        """Put a visit in the store as it is (loading, restoring from the archive)."""
        self.visits[visit.id] = visit
        self._by_pet.setdefault(visit.pet_id, {})[visit.id] = visit
        self._by_day.setdefault(visit.start.date(), {})[visit.id] = visit
        self._top_visit = max(self._top_visit, visit.id)

    def remove_visit(self, visit_id: int) -> Visit:
        visit = self.visits.pop(visit_id)
        del self._by_pet[visit.pet_id][visit_id]
        del self._by_day[visit.start.date()][visit_id]
        return visit

    def _next_visit_id(self) -> int:
        """The highest id plus one, as _next_id gives, without scanning every visit."""
        if self._top_visit not in self.visits:  # the newest visit went: find the new newest
            self._top_visit = max(self.visits, default=0)
        return self._top_visit + 1

    def move_visit(self, visit_id: int, pet_id: int) -> None:
        """Give a visit to another pet (merging duplicates)."""
        visit = self.remove_visit(visit_id)
        visit.pet_id = pet_id
        self.add_visit(visit)
